title: HPLC Sample Preparation Protocol
author: Kaitly Woodard
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yy3fxyn

steps.title: Add Hemolysate Reagent to Tubes
steps.instruction: Place 200 µL of Hemolysate Reagent into each 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add Blood and Vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of blood to each tube and vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at maximum speed for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer Supernatant to HPLC Vial
steps.instruction: Collect the hemolysate supernatant while avoiding DNA pellet contamination.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 75–100 µL of supernatant into an HPLC vial, taking care not to disturb the DNA pellet at the tube bottom.
If the pipette tip becomes sticky, discard the sticky debris and re‑pipette from the remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Label Vial and Remove Bubbles
steps.instruction: Prepare the HPLC vial for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Check that no bubbles are present at the bottom; remove bubbles by gently tapping the vial on the benchtop or by pipetting them out.

steps.title: Reserve HPLC Instrument Time
steps.instruction: Schedule the HPLC run and provide necessary documentation.

substeps.instruction: Reserve HPLC time on the calendar.
Provide the sample list and the prepared samples to JJZ.
